The final portfolio must contain at least five well-supported stories in every category. Treat social attention as a discovery signal rather than verification. More than half of the final stories must originate with independent, local or social discovery, using the first source in each story as the discovery source; established outlets may account for no more than half.

items.title: Delhi High Court upholds 7-year jail term for 5 men convicted in Delhi riots case
items.summary: The Delhi High Court on Tuesday upheld the trial court order sentencing five men to seven years' imprisonment for culpable homicide over the death of a 22-year-old man during the 2020 Delhi riots. Justice Madhu Jain dismissed the appeal filed by convicts Aman Kashyap, Devinder Kumar, Pradeep Rai, Ashish @ Goli and Arun Kumar against their conviction. The High Court ruled that the evidence showed “more than the mere presence” of the appellants in a crowd. “The common judgment of conviction dated 30.11.2024 and order on sentence dated 13.01.2025 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge-03, North-East District, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi, in Sessions Case No. 199/2021, arising out of FIR No. 87/2020 registered at Police Station Dayalpur, are upheld insofar as the present appellants are concerned,” Justice Jain concluded. Justice Madhu Jain The five men were convicted by the trial court under Sections 148 (rioting while armed with a deadly weapon) and 304 Part I (culpable homicide) of the Indian Penal Code (IPC). Notably, the case arose from an FIR registered at the Dayalpur police station after a man, identified as Monish, was allegedly chased and assaulted by a mob near Brijpur
